description: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet on Tuesday approved the establishment of a robotics and artificial intelligence (AI) park in Greater Noida spread over 69.52 acres, estimated to generate more than 1 lakh direct and indirect jobs and add ₹2,000 crore annually to the State’s economy at full scale.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet on Tuesday approved the establishment of a robotics and artificial intelligence (AI) park in Greater Noida spread over 69.52 acres, estimated to generate more than 1 lakh direct and indirect jobs and add ₹2,000 crore annually to the State’s economy.
